run_signed_distance_field_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a concave box, spheres, and a duck model
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like concave_box, sphere_1cm, and duck_vhacd into a pybullet simulation
configure_physics_simulation: configure pybullet physics with gravity, time step, and simulation stepping in a loop
connect_pybullet_gui: connect to pybullet in GUI mode and set the additional search path for URDF data
step_simulation_loop: step a pybullet simulation forward in a loop with a fixed time step and sleep
